title: DelegationRequest
description: Request that a parent sends to delegate work to another harness. The broker assigns run_id and span_id; a request that supplies them is rejected.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the request. Must be 1.

harness.description: Destination harness: lowercase identifier starting with a letter. Registration of the harness is checked by the broker.

agent.description: Agent the harness runs for this delegation, for example flowtask-constructor.

prompt.description: Text of the single turn sent to the agent.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory in which the agent runs.

model.description: Model identifier. Always explicit; the contract does not infer a default.

provider.description: Provider of the model. Always explicit.

first_event_timeout.description: Milliseconds allowed until the first valid event of the agent. When omitted, the broker configuration applies; the effective value is recorded on the run.

idle_timeout.description: Milliseconds allowed without activity after the first event, outside pauses. When omitted, the broker configuration applies.

wall_timeout.description: Milliseconds allowed for the whole run, pauses included. When omitted, the broker configuration applies.

parent_harness.description: Harness of the parent, when the parent runs in a harness.

parent_session_id.description: Identifier of the parent session, when the parent has one.

parent_run_id.description: Run of the parent that requests this delegation, when the parent is itself a delegated run.

ca_id.description: Identifier of the work item the delegation belongs to, when there is one.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier the run joins. When omitted, the broker generates one.

parent_span_id.description: Span of the parent operation the run is a child of, when present.
